title: Current tobacco/nicotine product use among high school students, by product (2024)

source.name: National Youth Tobacco Survey (NYTS) 2024
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: 2024 NYTS: e-cigarettes remained the most commonly used tobacco/nicotine product among US high schoolers for the 11th straight year (7.8%); nicotine pouches (e.g. Zyn) were the second most common product (1.8%, up from 1.5% in 2023); cigarettes fell to their lowest-ever recorded prevalence (1.7%). Source: CDC MMWR 'Notes from the Field: E-Cigarette and Nicotine Pouch Use Among Middle and High School Students -- United States, 2024.'
